title: 機械工学統合演習
subtitle: Advanced Exercises on Mechanical Engineering
educationalGoal: Students will: (1) Conduct synthetic exercises related to mechanical engineering. (2) learn and practice basic subjects in mechanical engineering that you had learned in the previous period.
advice: Students are acquired expertise in mechanical engineering through tasks, exercises, presentations, and discussions. Students are practiced in the fields of mechanical dynamics, material mechanics, thermodynamics, and fluid mechanics according to the FE test as a world standard. Students are learned the design problem on strength design or performance design.
requiredKnowledge: Review related subjects. Bring the textbooks used in related subjects, a calculator and an English dictionary.

activityGoals.body: Be able to solve given technical problems with expertise in mechanical engineering.
Be able to solve professional integration problems.
Be able to comprehensively utilize the knowledge of mechanical.
Be able to present and discuss technical issues.

 CLIP学習プロセスについて
 一般に、授業あるいは課外での学習では:「知識などを取り込む」→「知識などをいろいろな角度から、場合によってはチーム活動として、考え、推論し、創造する」→「修得した内容を表現、発表、伝達する」→「総合的に評価を受ける、GoodWork!」:のようなプロセス(一部あるいは全体)を繰り返し行いながら、応用力のある知識やスキルを身につけていくことが重要です。このような学習プロセスを大事に行動してください。
